categories.name: Skills and keywords
categories.measures: Required and preferred skills, tools and terms from the JD that appear in the CV.
categories.scoring: Weighted share of JD skills found in the CV; required skills count twice as much as preferred. A skill counts only if the CV states it.

categories.name: Experience relevance
categories.measures: Years of experience, seniority and domain compared with what the JD asks for.
categories.scoring: Start at 100; subtract in proportion to missing years, a lower seniority level and a different domain.

categories.name: Achievements and impact
categories.measures: Share of experience bullets that state a measurable outcome.
categories.scoring: Share of experience bullets with a concrete number, percentage, amount or scale. Vague claims do not count.

categories.name: Education and certifications
categories.measures: Degree, field of study and certifications the JD requires or prefers.
categories.scoring: 100 when every required item is met; a missing required item caps the score at 40; a missing preferred item costs less.

categories.name: Structure and clarity
categories.measures: Standard sections present, dated roles, concise bullets a reader can scan.
categories.scoring: Deduct for missing sections (summary, experience, skills, education), undated roles, and bullets longer than two lines.
